description: Change the title of an asset in the catalog by searching for it and updating its title.

parameters.name: catalog_search_query
parameters.semantic: The search query to find the asset in the catalog.

parameters.name: new_asset_title
parameters.semantic: The new title to assign to the asset.

preconditions: The user is logged in to the portal.
The catalog search page is open.

success_assertions.text: The asset title has been updated successfully.
The new title is visible in the catalog.
